# A cross-window insert leaves a stale mountedPromise, and updateVdom loops

## Context

`LegacyPopupReturnNL.spec.mjs:12` is red in every ten-shard `dev` run of the Brain-gated burn-in, and on both attempts of the retry ([run 38313618683](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38313618683)). It fails with "Request timed out". Hosted probes, from an unmerged branch:
- [Run 38313590362](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38313590362): after the drag's popup connects, the shared App worker answers neither the Neural Link nor its own main thread (`Neo.worker.App.getWorkerId()`, 3 s). The same call answers before the drag.
- [Run 38314276213](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38314276213): Chrome's debugger paused the App worker 12 times. Every stack runs `updateVdom` ← `afterSetVdom` ← `update` ← the `mountedPromise.then()` callback in `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` (line 1337). That is a microtask loop, so no message is ever handled again.
- [Run 38315013009](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38315013009): `this` in the paused frame is `legacy-return-widget`, the dragged widget, in all six samples. It reads `mounted: false`, `vnodeInitialized: true`, has a vnode, `hasBeenMounted: true`, holds a `_mountedPromise`, and has no `mountedPromiseResolve`, so that promise is already resolved. Its `parentId` is the popup's viewport.

## The Problem

`updateVdom()` on an unmounted component waits on `mountedPromise.then(() => me.update())`. Given a promise that an earlier mount resolved, the callback runs at once and finds the component still unmounted. It chains another `then`, and the loop never ends. The worker starves, and every later request to it times out.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/container/Base.mjs` `insert()`, on a `NeoInstance` from a parent in another window, with `removeFromPreviousParent: false`: `item._mounted = false`. This raw write skips `afterSetMounted()` on purpose, so the copy's later mount still triggers it. It also skips the unmount branch, whose first act is `delete me._mountedPromise`.
- `src/dashboard/Container.mjs` `onWindowConnect()` takes that branch during a window drag: `mainView.add(detachedItem.widget, false, !me.#isWindowDragging)`.
- `src/component/Abstract.mjs` `get mountedPromise()` returns any cached promise, whatever `mounted` reads now.

Design authority: the getter's JSDoc — "It also handles unmounting by resetting the promise, so it can be safely awaited again if the component is remounted". A raw unmount gets no reset.

## The Fix

The getter owns the cache, so it checks it. A cached promise with no pending resolver is resolved. While the component is unmounted, the getter discards it and creates a pending one. This covers every path that clears `mounted` without the hook. The container's raw write stays, because skipping the unmount hooks for a copy is intended.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A unit arm runs the real insert into another window that keeps the item in its previous parent. The item's `mountedPromise` must stay pending until the next mount, and settle on it.
- [ ] A unit arm pins the loop: one `update()` on an unmounted component holding a promise from an earlier mount runs `update()` once. Red before the fix (with the count capped), green after.
- [ ] Post-merge: `LegacyPopupReturnNL:12` passes in the next ten-shard `dev` run.

## Out of Scope

- Euclid's defect note on a staged value surviving a throwing `beforeSet`. It is a separate mechanism in `Neo.createConfig`.
- The other popup intermittents in #19657, for example #19684.

## Related

- #19657 and epic #19655. #18802 and #18820 (closed) cover the neighbouring mount-and-promise contracts.
